environment.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

weights.scope: routed expert block only; excludes dense/shared experts and router selection

aggregation.score: Per event: median across 5 round medians, each round median from 10 CUDA-graph replays. Batch score: equal-weight mean of the 3 event medians.
aggregation.variance: Sample variance uses ddof=1. Within-event variance describes 5 round medians; across-event variance describes 3 event medians; round-event-mean variance describes 5 means across the same 3 events.
aggregation.uncertainty: Descriptive variation within one tuning execution, not independent system-run uncertainty. Zero variance of repeated medians is not proof of zero measurement noise. No significance or CI is inferred.

scope.real_weights: Actual layer0 checkpoint routed expert tensors, hashed in weights.json; not synthetic weights.
scope.real_routes: 3 layer0 native decode matrices per B from the previous r05 capture; original ids and selected weights preserved.
scope.activations: synthetic standard-normal BF16; not captured model activations
scope.timing_includes: Captured native expert alignment, both GEMMs, activation and reduction.
scope.timing_excludes: Router selection, Python dispatch, skip policy, attention, full-model scheduling and conditioning graph duration.

cache_conditioning.method: read-modify-write separate CUDA graph before each measured MoE replay

scope.selection_boundary: Selected on these same native-only samples, not held-out confirmation. Small score reductions do not establish full-model service improvements.
scope.fair_comparison: Use the same emitted native-tuned configuration for every compared arm and remeasure service behavior.

graph_checks.scope: Fixed-arm output/count correctness on short synthetic prompts; no graph speed or task quality claim.
